notes.title: v1.1.3: Third Quantile Patch
notes.notes:
Hello, adventurers!
Another small patch, with boss item buffs, armor sprites, and some wacky fixes. Two quests now save correctly, and one is way easier to complete! Have fun.

v1.2 will have Weapons in the big inventory sprite, completing any outfit. Flashy! As for v1.3... it probably won't exist.

But v2.0 might. See you around!

[h2]v1.1.3: Third Quantile Patch[/h2]
[i]Save File Version is now 2. Previous save files will be deleted automatically.[/i]
Added: you can now see your equipped Armor in the inventory sprite. Only weapons to go!
Buffed: Holy Water now gives Wrathed enemies -20 Accuracy instead of doing literally nothing
Buffed: "Blitz" Crit "bonus" -10 -> -5
Buffed: "My Masterpiece" now has Primed
Buffed: "Corruption Incarnate" now inflicts 10 turns Marked instead of Regeneration
Buffed: "Climate" healing value every 12 turns 1 -> 3
Buffed: "High Acid Sensors" now also has Identify
Buffed: "Shocking Quads" charge drain from enemy Drones 1 -> 2
Nerfed: Cursing Trap curse 1 -> 0.5
Nerfed: "What Is Love?" achievement Drones 9 -> 6
Nerfed: the Designer quest is now easier (the correct Unit has different particles)
Changed: "Optimum" now has +1 Health on resisting effects (instead of Healing)
Changed: "Complex Vibrations" now has Automatic (instead of Negate Frozen)
Changed: Drones now have a bit different targeting.
[list]
[*] 	Drones with any Parts will instead prioritize active enemies near the player. They can still fire at their own nearest target.
[*] 	Parts determine which order they care about: Life Sensors will find low health enemies near the player.
[*] 	If no active enemies exist, they'll always default to their own nearest enemy.
[*] 	Naturally, Disconnected drones still always pick the nearest entity to murder!
[/list]Changed: using throwables is now done with Space (instead of Enter)
Changed: cooldowns of equipped items are now drawn below the item
Fixed: Statues, Void Spiders and the important Connected Unit are now saved/loaded correctly
Fixed: skipping from title screen to dungeon now properly deletes your old save file
Fixed: crash when force-talking to Alectron after completing a Goal
Fixed: invisible Traps would be detected when tab-swapping targets
Fixed: you can no longer swap places with Drones in Forcefields
Fixed: sometimes refunded bullets would not be aligned on the grid
Fixed: Disconnected and Feared now affect enemies immediately, with no more turn delay

notes.title: v1.1.2: Boots 'n Grippers Patch
notes.notes:
Hello, adventurers!
Small patch here, with the only major feature being Plasma Drone Parts. They are very rare, and there's barely any guaranteed way to get them, so do wait until I finish Minibosses.

Enjoy a slightly better version of Full Gear.

[h2]v1.1.2: Boots 'n Grippers Patch[/h2]
Added: Plasma Drone Parts!
[list]
[*] 	Plasma Parts appear only in certain places: Lost Chests, the Terminal chest, and maybe even more.
[*] 	They're super powerful in various ways, so use them!
[*] 	Minibosses, once finished, will always drop a Plasma part. Stay tuned.
[/list]Added: you can now see your Gauntlets in your big inventory sprite!
Added: you can now also see your Boots in the same way.
Buffed: Transistors freeze chance 5% -> 10%
Buffed: Biting Embrace freeze chance 10% -> 15%
Buffed: some Utilities, when destroyed with the Tongs, now also leave behind something else...
Nerfed: Void Spider base Attack 6 -> 4
Changed: reworded the Wrench's description so it doesn't technically lie anymore
Fixed: using any Bell would always activate nearby enemies
Fixed: the Grand Creator would sometimes block paths
Fixed: saving games would reset your cogwheel layout to Base
Fixed: loading games would not reinstall NPC tiles, sometimes blocking runs
Fixed: Ancient Modernization's description being overly long

notes.title: v1.0.3: The Visibility Patch
notes.notes:
Hello, adventurers!
The walls have looked ugly for too long, there's been requests to swap modes, and Boosts and Challenges are unclear. Also, crashes. But no worries! All these things have been fixed! This should reduce the amount of rage you feel when playing the game. Though not by a lot. It's a hard game.

[h3]Reviews[/h3]
First of all, I want to stress how [b]enormously [/b]important it is to leave a review. [i]Any[/i] review. Even if it's a single word. Once a store page reaches 10 reviews, it gains a permanent visibility boosts, which means more players, more feedback, and a better game. If you own Full Gear, please consider taking 1 minute to do so.

[h3]Keyboard Support[/h3]
I've also gotten several people asking about full keyboard support, and the answer is: [b]I'm working towards it.[/b] Using throwables with Tab/Space is a good step, next up will be scrolling through buttons with keyboard only. This could take a while, so please be patient and keep your mouse close for now.

Until then, enjoy a slightly better version of Full Gear.

[h2]v1.0.3: The Visibility Patch[/h2]
Added: the Modernizer, a Utility in the Base that allows you to switch to Modern mode.
[list]
[*]  There's been several requests to do this - it's the opposite of the Unlock All button.
[*]  Simply activate it and press Yes. The decision cannot be undone, as it only appears in Traditional Mode.
[*]  Naturally, the mode explaination texts have been adjusted accordingly.
[/list]Added: conversations and explainations on how Boosts and Challenges work
Added: you can now switch targets on throwables with Tab.
[list]
[*]  Works with bombs, guns, setups, and potions.
[*]  Targets active enemies, then enemies, then Drones, then traps, then forcefields.
[*]  Shoot with space. You can also change tiles with the arrow keys, WASD, etc.
[/list]Buffed: now, any Bells Marks nearby enemies for 20 turns.
[list]
[*]  This ensures that Marks are more common, and grants Bells a proper reason to hang on to.
[*]  It did give the Bell of Calling an indirect nerf: Marking radius 20 tiles -> 10 tiles, turns Marked 30 -> 20.
[/list]Nerfed: minimum enemy activation distance 8 -> 6
Nerfed: Void Spiders no longer automatically activate
Fixed: crash when Current's Eye would throw things on Traps
Fixed: rare crash when spawning enemies
Fixed: improved lighting a bit
Fixed: some walls being not visible, creating gaps in the surrounding walls
Fixed: with Green Gears, Berries would grant Max Health

notes.title: v1.0.2: The One Week Patch
notes.notes:
Hello, adventurers!

I hear you, in my dreams and my nightmares. I'd like [b]full keyboard support[/b] for Full Gear one day, and I'm slowly working towards it. The current extra numpad navigation is a good start, and inventory management and menu navigation will soon follow. Naturally, mouse and keyboard support will always remain, too.

[h1]v1.0.2: The One Week Patch[/h1]
Added: 6 new items, obtained from trading with NPC's! Worth a bunch, but not with the greatest stats.
Added: 2 new Achievements to help you know what's going on
Added: a conversation for why waiting too long is bad
Added: you can now use the arrow keys and numpad for attacking, using, opening and interacting with stuff
Added: you can now exit your inventory with the mouse
Changed: directly clicking on traps now walks you to them
Changed: extended the Backrooms music track
Fixed: in-dungeon conversations wouldn't reset the camera zoom
Fixed: Tokens wouldn't draw themselves in the middle of a cog
Fixed: Music being unusually quiet

As for bigger updates, expect version 1.1 to drop in a few weeks. There's a lot of items I still would like to have

notes.title: v1.0.1: The One Day Patch
notes.notes:
Hello, adventurers!

Yes, yes, a day 1 patch, very cliche. But I'm taking this day to fix some early stuff. Nothing too crazy - but sometimes, that's all you need.
[h1]v1.0.1: The One Day Patch[/h1]
Added: a new conversation about being able to zoom out
Changed: "Mute Music" and "Mute SFX" are now sliders!
Changed: The Chemist's UI is now a multi-choice menu, allowing better preservation of Food
Fixed: you can no longer obtain any Achievements in Debug Mode

I also changed the Demo to 1.0.1 (it used to miss some fixes), but that's it. I'll be having a little rest and working on bigger content for the next while. See you around!

notes.title: Full Gear: Cleaning the Canisters & Preparing for final release
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings, adventurers![/h1]
Two more weeks! The game's done, but I just need to be completely sure. Some minor improvements, but that's it. Couldn't find much. This will the last update before public 1.0, and I'm very happy with how it all turned out. Hopefully, someone out there will be happy, too.

[b]See you on March 1st![/b]

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[h2]v0.6: Cleaning the Canisters[/h2]
Added: particles or other visual feedback for some tags, and some items! Including but not limited to:
[list]
[*] 	Miner's Chestplate
[*] 	Reflex
[*] 	Nesasio Devices
[*] 	Guarded
[*] 	Distracting/Networked/Predicting
[*] 	Reveal Traps
[/list]Added: different icons for whenever a Landmark has been used
Buffed: the Compressed Canister can now inflict effects. [i]Please don't misuse this power.[/i]
Buffed: Resolutions bonus, at or below 25% Health -> 50% Health. [i]It was just way too niche before.[/i]
Buffed: Miner's pickaxe, Setups stack 3 -> 4. [i]Setups don't appear that often anyway.[/i]
Buffed: Thermal Quadron now has a Max Power of 10, so its special attacks will be performed faster.
Buffed: Current's Eye "I Am Connected" now always summons +1 Trap
Nerfed: all Boss-tier Gauntlets, base Accuracy 20 -> 15. [i]They often felt like an objective upgrade to any other Gauntlets.[/i]
Nerfed: Keeper's Hands accuracy 17 -> 11. [i]Applying Defenseless alone is already incredibly good.[/i]
Nerfed: Downpour X's "Snapshot" damage penalty 50% -> 67%
Nerfed: Current's Eye "Sawwheel" now gets +2/+1/+0/-1/-2/-3 damage at level 0/1/2/3/4/5
Changed: Units can no longer attack each other
Changed: enemies will no longer attack Connected Units
Changed: All Chests now obey the "Chests now contain X" items
Changed: picking any Toolbox now quickslots a slot and equips the Token automatically
Fixed: pathfinding when clicking would be blocked by invisible enemies
Fixed: using a Yellow Potion would show as using a Blue Potion
Fixed: the Bell Tower would very rarely restrict access to crucial areas
Fixed: trying to Execute a boss would just deal 0 damage

[h2]v0.6.1: Patch[/h2]
Added: signs to indicate which area you're going to
Added: indication for which tags you have in the Taglist
Buffed: challenge Half Gear: now also prevents chests from upgrading
Nerfed: challenge Well-Known Visitor: turns to enemy call, 25 -> 50
Fixed: crash when killing an enemy with multi-bullet Guns
Fixed: It Is Magic would empty crucial chests, and not even give Crit chance

[h2]v0.6.2: Patch[/h2]
Nerfed: Wrathed enemies Scrap drop chance, 100 -> 33
Changed: Guns now use the lowest-possible quality Bullet every time
Fixed: crash when using Reality Collapses
Fixed: crash when breaking the Bell Tower
Fixed: Resonance Bell Ringers can no longer heal dead entities

[h2]v0.6.3: Patch[/h2]
Buffed: Copper Tongs damage 3 -> 4, and "+3 damage" -> "+50% damage" vs targets on fire
Buffed: "Reckoning" range 2 -> 3, and Curse -5 -> +3
Nerfed: all "Kind Regards" are now Basic quality
Changed: Cult Array now has "+12 Crit vs Wrathed" instead
Changed: Weighed Darts now has "Stunned enemies lose 1 Health per turn" instead
Changed: World's Tiniest Violin now has "Whenever an enemy dies, your Drones gain Alert" instead

notes.title: Full Gear: Release Setup
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings, adventurers![/h1]
Nothing to see here! Just a bunch of crucial fixes before release is here.
[b]Full Gear will be releasing March 1st,[/b] at [b]10.00 dollars/euros[/b], on Steam! Mark your calendars, or just let the wishlist do it for you.
And if you've got any feedback, questions or funny images, you can join my Discord. Now's the time for bugs, crashes and feature requests!
[url=https://discord.gg/yDZKZCg]Discord Server Link[/url]

In the full version, there will also be 6 new, powerful, Titanium-quality items! They're not locked behind Goals and have pretty unique properties... but I won't spoil them just yet. You'll just have to wait a little longer.

See you around!

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[h3]v0.3: Release Setups[/h3]
Added: Steam cloud support. Game now also tries to pause if you have the Steam overlay open.
Added: a better crash handler. It should now be even easier to track those nasty crashes.
Added: the Administrator now tracks challenges/bonuses active, quest items, and boss order. Rejoice!
Added: two new tags!
	[list]
[*]"Primed": your Guns gain your Accuracy, and your Crit chance twice.
[*]"Identify": similar to some Parts, you can now see an enemy's attack stat.[/list]Added: visual indicator for passing a turn
Added: tutorial text for how to pass a turn
Added: numpad support! By default, they're mapped to walking, but you can change them to be mapped to quickslots.
Buffed: Turbo Gloves now has "Primed".
Buffed: Zoom-S now has "Identify".
Buffed: Quicksilver Stompers resistance -10 -> 5. [i]Because it's strange to have a healing build where fruit doesn't heal.[/i]
Buffed: Ungrounded Battery stun turns 5 -> 2. [i]It was too useless in most situations.[/i]
Nerfed: Warding Drone now only uses its charge when its target is nearby
Nerfed: Diver now only uses its charge when there's no walls between it and its target
Changed: the Battleaxe is now a part of the Spiked goal.
Changed: the Nail-Ridden Vest is now a part of the Shielded goal.
Changed: Bosses now immediately remove any stack of Fear
Changed: shortened descriptions of Sprocket Snakes, Thieves, and Thermal Drones
Changed: reduced the visual overload of the Chemist's room a bit
Fixed: crash from attacking Forcefields with the Copper Tongs
Fixed: crash from using the Amethyst Tongs when you just activated a Bell Ringer
Fixed: crash from using a quickslot item, then using inventory items
Fixed: crash from when a Lava Carrier would spawn
Fixed: you can no longer instantly break the Bell Tower with the Amethyst Tongs
Fixed: the Administrator didn't track Tokens from saved runs at all
Fixed: being able to use multiple Quickslots at the same time
Fixed: stolen items would have some attributes removed
Fixed: Lithium Shades would use normal weapon sound effect
Fixed: "Crypt Seeker" would appear as "Crypt Keeper"
Fixed: Widget Wielder would trigger too often
Fixed: using a Bell Ringer would consume all bells
Fixed: using an Ammo Oven should now add bullets to your inventory immediately
